purpose: Teach: 曲目/新曲/雑音/緻密/ロッカー/似顔絵/起こる/ちがい

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、コンサートの、本気で、絶対、曲目、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、楽しみだったわ
lines.en: Aoi, I was really looking forward to the concert setlist.
lines.style: Warm and immediate, slightly breathless with genuine excitement. Light attack on the opening. Upbeat but sincere, not performative. Brief pause before the main thought lands.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、好きな歌手の、絶対、新曲、絶対、毎日、絶対、聴いてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. I've been listening to my favorite artist's new songs every day.
lines.style: Open, conversational, natural rhythm. A small smile in the voice. Eager without being loud. Leans into the confession slightly, like sharing a small secret.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、夜の、絶対、雑音、絶対、少なくて、絶対、落ち着くわよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Your shop has such a nice calm to it at night—not much noise. It's really impressive.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, spoken slowly enough to let each observation land. Soft, appreciative tone. The rhythm of someone noticing details and wanting to acknowledge them.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、緻密、絶対、な計画、絶対、立てて、絶対、お店、絶対、運営してるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I run the shop with pretty meticulous planning. Everything has its place.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but warm, a hint of quiet pride beneath. Steady pace. Not boasting, just stating fact. Slight softness on the personal details.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、ロッカー、絶対、お客様、絶対、便利よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The lockers in your shop are so convenient for customers.
lines.style: Observant and sincere. Moderate pace, letting the compliment sit naturally. Warm undertone. Speaking to something Aoi has clearly thought through.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様の、絶対、似顔絵、絶対、描いて、絶対、プレゼント、絶対、しているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I actually draw little portraits of customers sometimes and give them as gifts.
lines.style: A touch of shyness beneath the statement. Slower, more deliberate. Like revealing something she cares about but doesn't make a big deal of. Small smile audible.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、トラブル、絶対、起こる、絶対、と、絶対、すぐに、絶対、対応するよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: When problems come up in the shop, you handle them right away. That's really something.
lines.style: Observational and steady. Genuine recognition of capability. Moderate pace, no rush. Warmth underneath—she's seen this happen and values it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様の好みの、本気で、絶対、ちがい、絶対、葵、絶対、見抜くようにしているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I try to notice the differences in what each customer likes and remember them.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest, almost conversational. Modest about the skill. Steady eye-level delivery. A pause before 'remember'—it matters to her.
